_comment: Raise a budget only in a pull request whose verification report explains why. See scripts/perf.ts.

budgets.reason: The core stylesheet ships to every consumer unconditionally; 0.7 adds a forced-colors block of about 0.3 KB, 0.9 adds the playground styles (about 0.9 KB gzip, measured).

Unminified source size of packages/doq/styles.css, the file consumers import. 0.9 adds about 6.3 KB for the playground (controls, toolbar, events, code panel, dialog, forced-colors and reduced-motion rules).

JavaScript loaded before a documentation page is interactive (entry + modulepreload chunks). Includes the host's Volt UI, Lumen Icons and Angular Movement; Doqs's own share is the part that grows with the library.
All JavaScript of the embedded showcase including lazy per-document chunks; grows with content, so a jump without new content is a regression.
Stylesheet linked by a documentation page (host styles + Doqs core).
Pagefind index, fragments and filters for the committed documents; scales with content and versions, not with library code.
Pages prerendered for the committed content and its archive; an unexpected extra page means a duplicate route.
JavaScript loaded before a documentation page is interactive in the docs-first showcase (no host UI libraries).
All JavaScript of the docs-first showcase including lazy per-document chunks.
Stylesheet linked by a documentation page in the docs-first showcase. 0.9: the core stylesheet gained the playground styles (about 0.9 KB gzip).
Pagefind index, fragments and filters for the committed documents.
Pages prerendered for the committed content, its archive and the not-found view.

JavaScript the official landing loads before it is interactive. It was 139,600 B before the site adopted Doqs for its own documentation; the documentation region (Doqs, Analog's Markdown renderer, Prism) is a lazy route, and an eager import of it measured 260,194 B.
All JavaScript of the official site including the lazy documentation chunks; grows with documentation content.

Stylesheet linked by the landing and the documentation (host Tailwind and Volt styles plus the Doqs core stylesheet). It was 11,160 B before the documentation was added. 0.9: the Doqs core stylesheet gained the playground styles (about 0.9 KB gzip).
Pagefind index of the official documentation (19 pages: 0.9 adds the Interactive playgrounds guide).
The landing, the documentation index and 19 documents (0.9 adds the Interactive playgrounds guide); an unexpected extra page means a duplicate route.

Analog bundles the frontmatter and a loader of every Markdown file of every version into the first-loaded JavaScript; Doqs cannot lazy-load that through a supported Analog API. Measured 20 -> 200 generated documents (+ half as many archived): 52 B gzip per document; 20 -> 1000: 46 B. A jump means Doqs added per-document work to the browser bundle.
